title: Clever Dripper brewing guide
scope: Crema Coffee Roasters' 25 g / 400 g water-first recipe in a large Clever with #4 wedge paper; Ozone small-brewer coffee-first recipe is a separate variant.

sources.title: HandyBrew: Clever and HandyBrew shutoff systems
supports: Clever uses an additional paper filter; HandyBrew uses built-in filters

sources.title: Clever Dripper Brewing Guide
supports: 25 g coffee and 400 g water, 1:16 by mass
#4 paper and grind finer than ordinary drip
Water immediately after boiling; coffee addition starts timer
Gentle initial mixing, 120-second crust stir, 30-second settlement, release at 150 seconds

sources.title: Clever Dripper Brew Guide
supports: Bottom valve opens on contact with mug or carafe
300 ml brewer uses size 2 papers; 500 ml uses size 4
15 g / 250 g coffee-first recipe at 95 C, medium filter grind
Start clock at water pour, stir 15 seconds, lid, release at 135 seconds, 180-210-second finish reference

sources.title: Clever Dripper Brew Guide
supports: Separate 16 g / 240 g water-first recipe, not the selected baseline
Finer grind for sour or flavourless results; coarser for bitter results
Larger batches can require coarser grind and careful saturation

sources.title: The Ultimate Clever Dripper Technique
supports: Named original source of the existing 15 g / 250 g app recipe; video fetching failed, so no new direct content verification is claimed

recipe.name: Crema large-Clever water-first starting recipe
equipment: Stable heat-safe server with capacity for the batch

water_temperature_c.control: user: freshly boiled water poured promptly; boiling temperature depends on local conditions

recipe.grind_description: Finer than ordinary drip coffee, with particle texture described by Crema as wet sand; do not wet dry grounds before brewing.

expected_time_s.clock_start: Coffee enters the already-filled brewer; initial stirring is included
expected_time_s.clock_end: No standing water remains above the bed and drainage has diminished to occasional drips; time is a reference, not a forced stop

recipe.completion_signal: No standing water above the coffee bed and flow diminished to occasional drips.

steps.instruction: Fold and fit #4 paper, rinse with hot water and discard rinse water. Move Clever off the server onto a level non-actuating surface; tare scale.
steps.why: Seats the filter, warms equipment and closes the bottom valve for immersion.
steps.completion: Paper sits neatly and rinse water has been discarded; brewer is off the server.

steps.instruction: Add all 400 g freshly boiled water before the coffee, leaving space below the rim.
steps.why: Preserves the selected water-first procedure and measured input.
steps.completion: Scale reads 400 g and water is retained.

steps.instruction: Add 25 g coffee, start timer at first coffee-water contact and stir gently until dry pockets disappear.
steps.why: Makes extraction time reproducible and wets the grounds.
steps.completion: All coffee is wet, with no dry pockets.

steps.instruction: Leave the mixture until the timer reaches 120 seconds, counting initial mixing within this interval.
steps.why: Allows the selected immersion period before disturbing the surface crust.

steps.instruction: At 120 seconds gently stir the surface crust back in, then leave it to settle for 30 seconds.
steps.why: Keeps the published crust-breaking and settling sequence intact.
steps.completion: Timer reaches 150 seconds after gentle stirring and settlement.

steps.instruction: At 150 seconds place Clever securely on a compatible server. Expect 45-75 seconds drainage, but observe completion rather than forcibly stopping at the reference time.
steps.why: The server opens the valve and paper separates the grounds from the drink.
steps.completion: No standing water above bed and flow has diminished to occasional drips.

steps.instruction: Lift by the handle onto the coaster after drainage, allow the beverage to cool and taste.
steps.why: Stops the valve being actuated and allows a safer, clearer taste assessment.
steps.completion: Brewer is stable off the server and the drink is comfortable to taste.

variants.name: Ozone smaller coffee-first recipe
variants.how_it_differs: 15 g coffee, 250 g water at 95 C, medium filter grind; add coffee before water, start timer with water pour, stir 15 seconds, cover, release at 135 seconds and expect completion around 180-210 seconds. Ozone identifies the nominal 300 ml version with #2 papers as suitable. Its instruction to remove at 210 seconds is a timed reference; the guide emphasizes observing drainage.

variants.name: Model and filter sizes
variants.how_it_differs: Ozone describes nominal 300 ml/#2 and 500 ml/#4 hardware. Volume labels are not beverage yields or a universal water-mass safety limit. Match papers to the actual model and leave coffee headroom; do not use 400 g in a small brewer.

troubleshooting.symptom: No flow after placing on server
troubleshooting.check_first: App-authored mechanical check: ensure server rim depresses the bottom actuator, brewer is stable and paper fits.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Use a compatible server and correctly seated matching filter; test fit with cold water before the next hot brew.

troubleshooting.check_first: App-authored checks: correct filter, compatible server, clean valve and gentle mixing; distinguish a mechanical problem from coffee resistance.
troubleshooting.adjustment: After equipment checks, try slightly coarser grounds next time. Keep other recipe quantities and timing unchanged.

troubleshooting.check_first: Confirm dose, water, freshly boiled start and complete ground saturation; taste after cooling.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Try a slightly finer grind while keeping other variables fixed.

troubleshooting.check_first: Confirm the selected recipe was followed and consider the bean's roast character.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Try slightly coarser grounds; compare after cooling. Drain speed alone is not an extraction measurement.

safety: Use a stable heat-safe server that supports the brewer and has room for the entire batch; test actuator fit with cold water first.
Keep below the rim with room for coffee; the 400 g recipe requires a large brewer.
Lift by the handle; avoid hot liquid and do not manually depress the outlet from beneath a filled brewer.
Let brewer cool, discard grounds and paper, then clean according to the model's instructions and check valve residue before reuse.
Dishwasher compatibility and seal disassembly were not verified; no universal instructions for either are asserted.

app_audit.finding: Water-first typed stages already carry 120-second crust/150-second release/approximately 60-second drain and 210-second total cues; the release defect is fixed.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Preserve the current correction. Do not infer a live defect from stale historical source records.

app_audit.finding: Water-first stage_04 and stage_05 digit substitutions correct historical timing. P1ExactGuidanceCatalog loads localized raw guidance and applies these errata during domain conversion.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Keep the reviewed overlay and verify it remains applied to every supported locale when integrating future copy.

app_audit.finding: Water-first ADD_WATER has a brew-elapsed start cue of zero, while the authored coffee-addition stage does not explicitly establish extraction clock origin. Correct later timestamps do not define what zero means.
app_audit.change_recommendation: State the selected recipe's clock origin explicitly and verify session start/advance event alignment; for Crema it is coffee addition, with water filling outside the extraction interval. Do not claim original Hoffmann clock verification from the blocked video.

app_audit.finding: The coffee-first 15/250 recipe cites SRC-CLEVER-COFFEECHRONICLER and SRC-HARIO-V60-OFFICIAL, whereas its 95 C, 15-second stir, 135-second release and 180-210-second finish correspond to the directly verified Ozone guide.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Add reviewed Ozone provenance for this published procedure without rewriting immutable historical source projections.

app_audit.finding: One clever_style profile specifies wedge_paper and BrewWaterMinusRetention(2.0). Exact recipes intentionally leave beverage output unresolved. Setup separately accepts an equipment-capacity override; paper size and headroom still depend on model.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Explain size-specific paper and headroom in reviewed guidance. Label any retention-based beverage result as an estimate; no universal retention coefficient or measured output is verified.

app_audit.finding: Clever is present in exact recipe/profile infrastructure but absent from the everyday BrewMethod enum. No Clever-specific entries were found in grinders.json; localized exact-recipe titles and guidance resources do exist.
app_audit.change_recommendation: Describe support as catalog/recipe guidance. Before any future everyday integration, validate selection, preparation, timers, persistence, grinder fallback and locales together; do not infer complete support from catalog presence.

uncertainties: Original Hoffmann video requests failed with fetch/cache errors. The existing code correction was inspected and Crema independently publishes the same 120/150-second sequence; this is not a new direct verification of every Hoffmann detail.

Manufacturer E.K. pages expose mechanism and paper-filter facts but no numerical capacity specification in the retrieved text. Nominal 300/500 ml and #2/#4 statements come from Ozone's own guide; check model packaging and actual headroom.
The E.K.-named Mare Terra PDF was read but not treated as a manufacturer manual because its authorship could not be independently established.
Ozone's fixed removal at 210 seconds is expressed as a reference in this guide; observable drainage completion takes priority. This editorial clarification is not an additional Ozone numeric claim.
Taste, drain time and collected yield depend on coffee, grind, filter, batch size, temperature and equipment; the guide has not been physically brewed.
Local boiling temperature is equipment/location dependent; no exact 100 C slurry measurement is asserted.
No device execution, translation-quality review, dishwasher approval or seal-disassembly verification was performed.
do_not_claim: The existing water-first app still releases at 120 seconds; it is already corrected to 150 seconds.
400 g brewing water equals 400 ml at all temperatures or yields 400 g beverage.
A nominal 500 ml brewer always safely accepts 500 g water plus grounds.
Every Clever model uses #4 paper, or Clever and Hario Switch have interchangeable filters or controls.
A single grind number, drain deadline, 2 g/g retention coefficient or decaf timing subtraction applies universally.
Coffee-first and water-first timings can be interchanged, or the Crema recipe is Hoffmann's exact 15/250 recipe.
Catalog presence proves everyday calculator, grinder or localization support, release readiness or physical brew validation.
